profile.name: Hannah Brooks
profile.summary: Registered nurse with four years on a 32-bed medical-surgical unit, including two years as relief charge nurse. BSN, Colorado RN license, BLS and ACLS.

descriptions: Care for five to six adult patients per shift, including post-op, sepsis and diabetic patients
Serve as relief charge nurse about six shifts a month, making assignments for nine nurses and handling admissions
Joined the unit's falls committee; hourly rounding changes we introduced cut falls from 11 to 4 in a year
Precept new graduate nurses and have oriented seven through their first 12 weeks
Managed medications and wound care for 12 rehab patients on day shift and documented every assessment in Epic
Taught patients and families how to manage new insulin and blood thinner routines before discharge
Worked with physical therapists to plan safe discharges for stroke and joint replacement patients
Sigma Theta Tau International Honor Society of Nursing
Certifications: BLS, ACLS, NIH Stroke Scale
Clinical: Telemetry, wound care, IV therapy
